# HAProxy — root-to-custom-context-sse

Proxy at /, app on /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The event stream and the client-to-server POSTs both ride the same prefix-adding rule, and the Location and Set-Cookie rewrites are unchanged from the WebSocket sibling.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/root-to-custom-context-sse/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# templates/add-prefix.cfg plus a refusal to upgrade: proxy at /, app on the
# /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# The event stream and the client-to-server POSTs both ride the same
# prefix-adding rule as every other request, and the response rewrites are
# unchanged. Only the deny below differs from the shared template.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    # HAProxy relays an upgrade with no configuration at all and has no keyword
    # to stop it, so the refusal is written out. The 501 comes from the proxy
    # rather than from Atmosphere.
    http-request deny deny_status 501 if { req.hdr(Upgrade) -m found }

    http-request set-path /app%[path]

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    http-response replace-header Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/app(/.*) \1\2
    # Anchored on the end of the value: Tomcat writes `Path=/app`, with no
    # trailing slash, so a regex expecting `/app/` matches nothing and the
    # browser at / never sends the session cookie back.
    http-response replace-header Set-Cookie (.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/app(;.*)?$ \1/\2
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
